If you are worried about family and friends judging you, think on how miserable you have been in your situation and remind them that first goes your own recovery.

Make sure that he has the potential to change. It's a full role reversal for him in this situation to all the things you had him do around the house on top of helping around the house, and being emotionally supportive. Both must want the same thing, and be willing to make sacrifices to enjoy life fully.
